title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces, cultural venues, and natural retreats at Bates College that require no admission or purchase for students and visitors.

cards.title: Bates College Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Olin Arts Center
cards.notes: Explore contemporary and modern art exhibitions at no cost. The museum is open to the public and serves as a major cultural hub on the edge of Lake Andrews.
cards.short_summary: A teaching museum offering free admission to all visitors to view its permanent collections and rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The public is welcome to view our exhibitions, free of charge. Admission Information: Free admission.
cards.source_title: Visit | Museum of Art | Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Saturday 10 AM – 5 PM (with extended hours until 7:30 PM on Mondays and Wednesdays during the academic year).

cards.title: Hiking Mount David
cards.subtitle: Mountain Avenue
cards.notes: Climb this 381-foot rocky outcrop for panoramic views of Lewiston and the campus. It is a popular spot for watching sunrises and stargazing with friends.
cards.short_summary: A short, five-minute hike to a secluded hilltop offering scenic views of the surrounding Maine countryside.
cards.evidence_claim: Mount David is a small hill next to campus... Trails maintained by students lead to a rocky summit with great views. This private property is a popular destination.
cards.source_title: Mount David | Campus Tour - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Accessible via trails off Mountain Avenue; open to the Bates community and respectful visitors.

cards.title: Lake Andrews
cards.subtitle: The Puddle
cards.notes: Walk the lakeside path or sit at the granite amphitheater. Four laps around the water equal one mile, making it a favorite for casual exercise and relaxation.
cards.short_summary: A central campus pond featuring a walking path and the Florence Keigwin Amphitheater for outdoor gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: A typical day finds walkers doing circuits on the lakeside path (four times around is about a mile) as students hang out at the granite amphitheater.
cards.source_title: Lake Andrews | Campus Tour - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; visitors are asked to respect shoreline vegetation and nesting ducks.

cards.title: Music Department Concerts
cards.subtitle: 75 Russell Street
cards.notes: Attend student and faculty musical performances throughout the semester. Most concerts held in this hall are open to the public without a ticket fee.
cards.short_summary: Free musical performances hosted by the Bates Music Department in the Olin Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: All Concerts will be held in the Olin Arts Center Concert Hall and are free of charge unless otherwise stated.
cards.source_title: Public Art Events | The Arts - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Check the online arts calendar for specific event dates and times; most are free and open to the public.

cards.title: The Little Room
cards.subtitle: Chase Hall Ground Floor
cards.notes: Play billiards, ping-pong, or foosball in this multi-room social space. It is a dedicated area for students to relax and engage in casual gaming.
cards.short_summary: A student social space in Chase Hall equipped with various table games and a karaoke area.
cards.evidence_claim: The “Little Room” is located on the ground floor of Chase hall... Included in this space: Billiards Table; Table Tennis/Ping-Pong Table; Foosball Table; Air Hockey Table.
cards.source_title: Student Spaces on Campus | Campus Life - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open to all Bates students on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Peter J. Gomes Chapel
cards.subtitle: 275 College Street
cards.notes: Visit this historic Gothic-style chapel for quiet reflection or to attend multifaith events. It serves as a peaceful sanctuary for the entire campus community.
cards.short_summary: A nondenominational chapel providing a space for solitude, serenity, and inclusive community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Open to all, Gomes Chapel is a place of solitude, serenity, and community... Inside, banners of the world's major faith traditions offer reminders of Bates' inclusive founding.
cards.source_title: Gomes Chapel | Campus Tour - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open for access with a Bates ID; public access is available during scheduled events.

cards.title: Thorncrag Nature Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Montello Street
cards.notes: Hike over four miles of trails in this 450-acre preserve. It is the highest point in Lewiston and offers birdwatching and winter sledding opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A large wildlife preserve and bird sanctuary with extensive hiking trails and scenic overlooks.
cards.evidence_claim: Thorncrag Sanctuary is a 450 acre nature preserve... Fees: No. Passive recreation... is actively encouraged.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset. Dogs and bicycles are not permitted.

cards.title: Muskie Archives & Special Collections
cards.subtitle: 70 Campus Avenue
cards.notes: Browse rare books and historical records of the college. The archives are open for research and often feature exhibits on local and institutional history.
cards.short_summary: The college's repository for historically significant records, rare books, and the papers of Senator Edmund S. Muskie.
cards.evidence_claim: The library serves a broad and diverse audience by producing exhibits, conducting educational and outreach programs... Walk-in, in-building use... available for those doing research.
cards.access_notes: Research hours are typically Monday-Friday; appointments are recommended for specific collection access.

cards.title: Ladd Library
cards.subtitle: 48 Campus Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the open shelves and study spaces in the main campus library. It is a central hub for academic work and quiet group meetings.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic library at Bates, offering extensive collections and diverse study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Items on open shelves are available for anyone to use in the library... Ladd Library is open to the Bates community via card access.
cards.source_title: Access and Borrowing | Library - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Card access required for entry; open late during the academic semester.

cards.title: Mount David Summit
cards.subtitle: Pettengill Hall
cards.notes: Attend this annual celebration of student research and creative work. It is free and open to the public, showcasing posters, talks, and performances.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus-wide symposium highlighting undergraduate research and artistic achievement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mount David Summit is Bates' annual campus-wide celebration of student academic achievement... Events are... open to the Bates community as well as the general public.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April; check the college calendar for the specific Friday date.
